mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.remark, g.marketing_occupancy_type AS marketingOccupancyType, g.marketing_occupancy_task_id AS marketingOccupancyTaskId, g.marketing_locked_at AS marketingLockedAt, g.system_builtin AS systemBuiltin, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a WHERE a.account_group_id = g.id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AS accountCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.account_group_id = g.id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.login_state = 1) AS onlineCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.account_group_id = g.id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.risk_status > 1) AS riskCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.account_state = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.account_state = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.mute_status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.account_state = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.account_group_id = g.id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AS restrictedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.account_group_id = g.id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.account_state = 3) AS bannedCount, g.created_at AS createdAt, g.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM account_group g WHERE ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.system_builtin = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select.if: SELECT task.id AS taskId, task.status AS taskStatus, pull_task.resource_status AS resourceStatus, CASE WHEN pull_task.resource_status = 3 THEN 'RELEASING' WHEN task.status = 5 THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE NULL END AS occupancyOverrideType FROM marketing_task task LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_task pull_task ON pull_task.marketing_task_id = task.id AND pull_task.tenant_id = task.tenant_id WHERE task.deleted_at IS NULL AND task.id IN #{taskId}
SELECT task.id AS taskId, task.status AS taskStatus, NULL AS resourceStatus, NULL AS occupancyOverrideType FROM marketing_task task WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT g.id FROM account_group g LEFT JOIN marketing_task task ON task.id = g.marketing_occupancy_task_id AND task.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND task.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_task pull_task ON pull_task.marketing_task_id = task.id AND pull_task.tenant_id = task.tenant_id WHERE g.deleted_at IS NULL
AND g.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NULL
AND g.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NOT NULL AND task.status = 5 AND (pull_task.resource_status IS NULL OR pull_task.resource_status != 3)
AND g.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NOT NULL AND pull_task.resource_status = 3
AND g.marketing_occupancy_type = 1 AND (task.status IS NULL OR task.status != 5)
AND g.marketing_occupancy_type = 2 AND (task.status IS NULL OR task.status != 5) AND (pull_task.resource_status IS NULL OR pull_task.resource_status != 3)
AND g.marketing_occupancy_type = 3 AND (task.status IS NULL OR task.status != 5)
AND g.marketing_occupancy_type = 4 AND (task.status IS NULL OR task.status != 5)
AND g.marketing_occupancy_type = 5 AND (task.status IS NULL OR task.status != 5)
AND 1 = 0
AND g.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NOT NULL AND ( CAST(g.marketing_occupancy_task_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{occupiedTaskKeyword}, '%') OR task.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{occupiedTaskKeyword}, '%') )
AND g.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NOT NULL AND task.business_type = #{occupiedBusinessType}
ORDER BY g.id

SELECT g.id AS groupId, g.marketing_occupancy_type AS occupancyType, g.marketing_occupancy_task_id AS taskId, g.marketing_locked_at AS lockedAt, task.business_type AS taskBusinessType, task.task_name AS taskName, task.status AS taskStatus, pull_task.resource_status AS resourceStatus, CASE WHEN pull_task.resource_status = 3 THEN 'RELEASING' WHEN task.status = 5 THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE NULL END AS occupancyOverrideType, CASE WHEN task.business_type = 2 THEN COALESCE(pull_task.marketing_account_total_count, 0) ELSE COALESCE(task.selected_account_count, 0) END AS marketingAccountTotalCount, CASE WHEN task.business_type = 2 THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_pull_marketing_account_stat pull_used WHERE pull_used.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND pull_used.task_id = task.id ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketing_account_occupancy ordinary_used WHERE ordinary_used.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND ordinary_used.marketing_task_id = task.id ) END AS marketingAccountUsedCount FROM account_group g LEFT JOIN marketing_task task ON task.id = g.marketing_occupancy_task_id AND task.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND task.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_task pull_task ON pull_task.marketing_task_id = task.id AND pull_task.tenant_id = task.tenant_id WHERE g.id = #{groupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
